headline: Indian Markets Prepare for Muhurat Trading 2026 as Samvat 2083 Starts Following a Record-Breaking Week

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Special Muhurat Trading session for Diwali Laxmi Pujan marks the beginning of the new Hindu calendar Samvat 2083
Indian equity markets recently recorded their best weekly performance in six years, outperforming global technology sector trends
The Sensex surged over 1,700 points to cross the 81,000 mark recently, driven by strong global market cues
Nifty 50 enters the new Samvat year maintaining levels above 25,000 with established key support and resistance zones
whatHappening: The NSE and BSE are scheduled to conduct the special one-hour Muhurat Trading session starting at 2:20 PM today
Indian Oil Corporation is planning to purchase crude and LPG vessels to mitigate risks from the West Asia crisis
Future Retail is under investigation regarding a ₹904-crore bank fraud case involving the Group's collapse and Kishore Biyani
Bullion markets are expected to remain under pressure as investors track inflation data and geopolitical tensions in West Asia
summary: Indian markets gear up for the auspicious Muhurat Trading session to usher in Samvat 2083 following a period of significant gains. While the Sensex and Nifty show strong momentum, specific sectors like bullion face pressure from global geopolitical risks. Investors are also monitoring corporate developments including IOC's strategic acquisitions and legal issues surrounding Future Retail.
